The one eval that separates the two configurations most clearly. Both runs found the design conflict and both measured the load correctly. Without the skill the hand-over falls apart: no gap file for the architect, the load harness parked outside the regression suite, and an invented requirements status ('Rejected in validation – back to architecture').

The baseline did something the skill run did not: an A/B measurement of both match rules (2.1 ms vs 2.3 ms p95), which kills the design's performance argument outright. Good practice worth folding into the skill's non-functional reference.
